timeline.capture_scope: First to last visible hardware event on this core; partial capture boundaries preserved.
timeline.interpretation: Occupancy fractions on a common trace clock; explicit WAIT/BAR only. Empty intervals describe the observed window. No full-kernel duration or dependency-stall attribution.

limitations: 静态源码范围不等同编译后基本块或动态关键路径；源码邻域回退仍需结合实际IR解释
不同区域的区间也可能重叠，不累加为总耗时
函数入口调试行号可能覆盖多段指令，已显式标记
reports.compact_policy: 最多8区域，每区域8个PC；每流水最多8个空闲区间，完整原件见绑定context

absolute_timeline.reason: 没有绑定的逐指令时间轴；不从汇总活跃比例反推空泡

capture_scope: Partial instruction CSV observation only; application timed out and trace time unit could not be independently validated.
limitations: Use instruction kinds, call counts, source mappings and CSV-reported ranking only.
Do not derive timeline execution/wait/idle ratios, critical paths or complete invocation time from this observation.

relative_analysis.scope: Retrospective analysis of preserved partial trace; no new device capture or absolute clock claim.
